full_source: C/S complete legal2D editing denominators retained, including uncertified/no-hit; uncertified editing domain is not confirmed road or a claim that densification can repair it; A only confirmed road
full_premult_RGB_MAE: abs(actual road premult P - opaque teacher T) averaged on full fixed2D editing source, no division by alpha
primary_color_HF: fixed common stable: parent and final >=.95, plus every intermediate >=.95; same domain for every stage
common_stable_partition: parent>=.95 and final>=.95; transient alpha loss separately recorded
newly_covered_partition: parent<.95 and final>=.95; final-only RGB/HF with full final-stable source as filter context
edge: fixed RGB tensor2/255 NMS and1px match; appearance, not lane geometry truth
dark: highalpha>=.95 and unpremult meanRGB<.05 and teacher meanRGB>=.10, descriptive only
joint_occlusion: road alpha is not final alphaT; absent actual contribution export => null
surface_subset: fixed old supported mesh plus independently recertified original measured plane; no surface evidence remains unconfirmed; certified-road gaps separate from all2D-source gaps
